blocks.text: LEGAZPI CITY — The Department of Agrarian Reform distributed 1,136 land titles covering 1,741.43 hectares to 1,052 agrarian reform beneficiaries (ARBs) across Bicol on Tuesday. Agrarian Reform Secretary Conrado M. Estrella III led the distribution during a regionwide land titling event at the Legazpi City Convention Complex in Albay. The titles cover agricultural lands under the Comprehensive Agrarian Reform Program and include emancipation patents, certificates of land ownership award, and electronic titles issued under the Support to Parcelization of Lands for Individual Titling (SPLIT) Project.
